# Comments sample

An %%inline%% comment, and %%another one%% right after.

Before a %%multi
line%% comment with a soft break inside.

Formatting inside a comment: %%a *b* c%% stays readable.

Double dashes: %%x --> y -- z%% get neutralized.

Percent literal: 50% stays as-is.

This %% stays literal because it never closes.
